style: Minimal ivory-and-gold pictograms with smooth enamel faces, gold rims, and restrained raised bevels.

notes.meaning: Separate emblems for a resolved standings tiebreak, a tie after two configured metrics, a tie on all three metrics, equal round TR, and shared game placements.
notes.scope: Tournament standings and recorded round placements; each emblem uses the rule below.
notes.exclusion: The in-game money-to-production tiebreak chain is not represented.
notes.implementation: Artwork and preview only; no achievement eligibility code changed.

rules.impossible: There exists another player with identical tournament points, TR margin, Buchholz, and TPerf. Requires an explicit comparison of all three metrics; tieKind === complete checks only the two configured tiebreakers and is insufficient on its own.
rules.dead-heat: A non-last-place player has the same terraform_rating as the player immediately below them in recorded placement order. Compare those adjacent players directly; trMarginFor is usable only when it represents that same comparison.
rules.tied-game-win: Recorded placements are [1, 1, 3, 4], and this player is one of the two position === 1 players.
rules.tied-game-second: Recorded placements are [1, 2, 2, 4], and this player is one of the two position === 2 players.
rules.tied-game-third: Recorded placements are [1, 2, 3, 3], and this player is one of the two position === 3 players.
rules.megacredit-is-king: Won a game using the megacredit tiebreaker. Equal TR with different recorded placements alone does not establish which in-game tiebreaker was used; explicit result data is required to verify this rule.

notes.identicalTwins: Equal tournament points and both configured tiebreaker values; the players remain tied and share a rank. The second tiebreaker has not separated them.
notes.resolvedTieCaution: A non-null tieKind also includes complete ties. Eligibility for Won It on Tiebreaker must require a resolving metric and exclude complete ties.
